name: OBJECTID
description: Esri-generated feature identifier; unique row identifier within this release.

name: REACH_ID
description: River reach identifier used to link to HydroATLAS.

name: GOID
description: Global object identifier used to identify a reach across free-flowing-river assessments and link dams to reaches.

name: NOID
description: Network object identifier; same purpose as GOID.

name: NUOID
description: One or more upstream NOIDs separated by underscores; an empty value identifies a headwater reach.

name: NDOID
description: Next downstream NOID; zero denotes a terminal reach.

name: CON_ID
description: Continent identifier: 1 North America, 2 South America, 3 Europe, 4 Africa, 5 Asia, 6 Australia.

name: CONTINENT
description: Continent name; boundaries are delineated from HydroBASINS.

name: COUNTRY
description: Country name.

name: BAS_ID
description: HydroSHEDS hydrological river basin identifier.

name: BAS_NAME
description: Hydrological basin name when available.

name: LENGTH_KM
description: Length of the river reach.

name: VOLUME_TCM
description: Volume of the reach channel, calculated from width, length, and depth.

name: UPLAND_SKM
description: Upstream watershed area of the river reach.

name: DIS_AV_CMS
description: Average long-term (1971–2000) naturalized discharge.

name: RIV_ORD
description: River order calculated from long-term average discharge using logarithmic classes.

name: ERO_YLD_TON
description: Erosion yield summed within the river reach catchment; not accumulated along the network.

name: HYFALL
description: Presence (1) or absence (0) of one or more waterfalls along the reach.

name: BB_ID
description: Backbone river identifier for a contiguous source-to-terminus flow path.

name: BB_NAME
description: Backbone river name.

name: BB_LEN_KM
description: Backbone river length, the sum of its reach lengths.

name: BB_DIS_ORD
description: Discharge order of the most downstream reach in the backbone river.

name: BB_VOL_TCM
description: Backbone river volume, the sum of its reach volumes.

name: BB_OCEAN
description: Indicates whether the backbone river is directly connected to the ocean (1) or not (0).

name: INC
description: Analysis filter: Grill et al. (2019) included reaches with value 1 in analysis results.

name: DOF
description: Degree of fragmentation pressure index (0–100%).

name: DOR
description: Degree of regulation pressure index (0–100%).

name: SED
description: Sediment trapping pressure index (0–100%).

name: USE
description: Water consumption pressure index (0–100%).

name: URB
description: Urbanization pressure index (0–100%).

name: RDD
description: Road construction pressure index (0–100%).

name: FLD
description: Inundation (floodplain) extent in the river reach catchment (%).

name: CSI
description: Connectivity Status Index (0–100%); 100% is full connectivity.

name: CSI_D
description: Dominant pressure factor; documented values include DOF, DOR, SED, USE, RDD, and URB.

name: CSI_FF
description: Indicates whether CSI is below (0) or above (1) the 95% free-flowing threshold.

name: CSI_FF1
description: Two-category free-flowing status: free-flowing (1) or non-free-flowing (3).

name: CSI_FF2
description: Three-category status: free-flowing (1), good connectivity (2), or impacted (3).

name: CSI_FFID
description: Identifier for contiguous river stretches.

name: Shape_Length
description: Length value maintained by the ESRI File Geodatabase; see LENGTH_KM for reach length.

name: Shape
description: Source MultiLineString reach geometry, stored as WKB without coordinate transformation.

source_field_metadata.ARROW:extension:name: geoarrow.wkb
